name: Zyrn
description:
## About Zyrn

Zyrn is a powerful, fully-managed ecommerce platform built for agencies and businesses that need more than just a store. Engineered for speed, scale, and flexibility, Zyrn gives you everything to launch, manage, and grow high-performance online businesses—without the complexity.

### What Zyrn Delivers

Zyrn brings together the full stack of modern ecommerce tooling into one cohesive platform. From multivendor marketplaces to AI-powered product discovery, every feature is designed to help your clients sell more, operate faster, and scale without limits.

### Built on Laravel

A custom PHP/Laravel store management system — fully customizable so you can shape the store however you need. Multivendor, multi-store inventory, PWA, image search, CMS, and enterprise caching (FPC, Varnish, Elasticsearch, Octane, CDN) out of the box.

hero.title: Enterprise Ecommerce, Muling Binuo
hero.subtitle: Fully-managed Laravel ecommerce platform para sa agencies at businesses.

features.title: Multivendor Marketplace
features.description: Launch a marketplace where multiple sellers can list, manage, and fulfill their own products—all from a single storefront you control.

features.title: Multi-Store Inventory
features.description: Manage stock across unlimited warehouses and locations from one centralized dashboard. Real-time sync, zero guesswork.

features.title: Generative AI Capabilities
features.description: Let AI recommend the right products to the right customers at the right time—boosting conversions and average order value.

features.title: Payment Integration
features.description: Connect seamlessly with trusted providers including PayPal, Cash on Delivery, and Bank Transfer. More ways to pay, fewer abandoned carts.

features.title: PWA Support
features.description: Your store behaves like a native mobile app—fast, responsive, and installable—without building one from scratch.

features.title: Search by Image
features.description: Powered by TensorFlow machine learning. Customers upload a photo, and Zyrn finds matching or similar products instantly.

features.title: Built-In CMS
features.description: Manage pages, banners, and static content without touching code. Your marketing team stays in control.

features.title: Expanded Category View
features.description: All categories and subcategories displayed clearly. Better navigation, faster discovery, higher engagement.

faq.question: Is Zyrn fully customizable?
faq.answer: Yes. Zyrn is a custom PHP/Laravel store management system—you can shape catalogs, checkout, shipping, payments, attributes, and storefront experience to match whatever your client needs.

faq.question: Can I run a multivendor marketplace?
faq.answer: Yes. Multiple sellers can list, manage, and fulfill products from a single storefront you control, with centralized operations for the agency or business owner.

faq.question: What payment methods are supported?
faq.answer: Out of the box: PayPal, Cash on Delivery, and Bank Transfer, with a flexible payments layer so more providers can be added as needed.

faq.question: How does Zyrn handle scale and performance?
faq.answer: Enterprise infrastructure includes Full Page Caching, Elasticsearch with typo tolerance, Varnish, load balancing, Laravel Octane, and CDN integration—built for high-traffic catalogs (10M+ products) with ~500ms load targets.

faq.question: Does it support multiple languages and currencies?
faq.answer: Yes. Localisation for multiple languages and multi-currency checkout so customers shop and pay in their local currency.

faq.question: Who is Zyrn for?
faq.answer: Agencies and businesses that need more than a basic store—custom storefronts, marketplaces, multi-warehouse inventory, and enterprise tooling without piecing together disconnected SaaS products.
